claims.assertion: Athena said diviners see their own futures; when they perceive another’s, personal interpretation can distort the reading.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)

claims.assertion: Athena said no psychic or mentor can give someone life meaning; connecting with other selves is possible, but the person must access that information.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: She could not provide it for someone else.

claims.assertion: Athena said life’s purpose is happiness in what one has, advising people to release the search for a single true purpose.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: She said complexity can make life harder, and recommended satisfaction in simple things.
